newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise as demand builds up.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise as demand builds up.

text.p: Sugar prices rose futher on Wednesday as demand had begun building up for the peak summer months of May and June, dealers said.

In Ready, S-30 sugar rose 30 rupees to 1,390/1,420 rupees per quintal and M-30 gained 10/15 rupees to 1,420/1,487 rupees per quintal. On Tuesday S-30 sugar prices rose 10/15 rupees and M-30 by 9.0/10 rupees per quintal.
"The market is very firm in anticipation of surge in demand," said a dealer.
The market is closed on Thursday for a local holiday.
